# Yash Kshatriya

> Yash Kshatriya is an AI/ML and full-stack developer and a B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at LJ University (started 2024). He is currently a Frontend Developer Intern at Kiara TechX. He builds React/TypeScript web apps, serverless backends on AWS, and machine-learning models served behind APIs.

## Focus areas

- Full-stack web: React and TypeScript front ends; Django or Node.js APIs with PostgreSQL.
- Serverless on AWS: Lambda, API Gateway (HTTP + WebSocket), DynamoDB, S3, SES, KMS; infrastructure as code with Terraform and AWS SAM.
- Machine learning: training and evaluating models in PyTorch, scikit-learn and XGBoost, then serving them behind an API.
- Geospatial data: PostGIS queries and Leaflet / OpenStreetMap maps for scoring and comparing real-world locations.

## Projects

- [Obrix](https://github.com/Yash19k/Obrix-Location-Intelligence-Platform): AI-powered geospatial location-intelligence platform. Scores candidate sites on accessibility, infrastructure and surrounding-area data using multi-factor suitability scoring, radius catchment and amenity-proximity analysis. Stack: React, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Leaflet. Live: https://obrix-frontend.onrender.com/
- [Quibble](https://github.com/Yash19k/quibble): Real-time multiplayer quiz game on serverless AWS. A host shares a 6-character code and up to 250 players race the same countdown from their phones, with server-authoritative timing, reconnect-safe games, 5 question types and QR join. Stack: API Gateway WebSockets, Lambda (Node.js 22), DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, AWS SAM.
- [DropVault](https://github.com/Yash19k/dropvault): Serverless secure file sharing on AWS. Resumable multipart uploads straight to S3, expiring links by email/URL/QR, download limits, stats, instant revocation and per-user KMS encryption. Stack: React 19, Python Lambdas, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, SES, KMS, Terraform, GitHub Actions. Live: https://dropvault.d1m5hv4o1y7mm2.amplifyapp.com
- [AgriSmart AI](https://github.com/Yash19k/Agrismart-AI): AI crop-disease detection and farm advisory platform (Smart India Hackathon 2026). ConvNeXt-Tiny leaf-disease classifier with 38 classes at 98.1% macro-F1, Random Forest crop recommendation, XGBoost irrigation scheduling and a multilingual (English/Hindi/Gujarati) AI agronomist. Stack: PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Django REST Framework, React 19, Groq LLM. Live: https://agrismart-ai-mu.vercel.app
